events.title: Australian politics live: Pauline Hanson offers qualified apologies to Albanese and Indigenous Australians over podcast comments
events.description: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The South Australian premier, Peter Malinauskas , says there is optimism that steel making will continue in his state, after the closure of a major blast furnace at Whyalla was announced yesterday. Speaking to ABC News Breakfast from Whyalla and donned in some hi-vis, Malinauskas says there was disappointment, heartbreak, but also a sense of inevitability when the announcement was made. [Whyalla] has the capacity to be a viable operation but it hasn’t been recapitalised. The blast furnace is over 60 years old. It was first built in 1965 and blast furnaces of this age not to be realigned on a frequent basis. This hasn’t been done in 20 years. The fact it’s still going is a miracle. We need to have the plant recapitalised and that’s exactly the plan we have in conjunction with the federal government … if we lose this capacity behind me, this country doesn’t have structural steel-making capacity and we can’t afford that. If Pauline Hanson wants to take us down the road of Americanising our politics, so people in a family who disagree on political issues can’t speak to each other any longer, this is the pathway to do it … We’ve got lots of challenges facing Australia, but we’re not going to solve them by punching down on things that are brilliant about our country. So I think it’s rotten. I think it’s awful. I think it’s ugly. I just don’t agree with those comments. But I actually do agree with Senator Jacinta Nampijinpa Price when she says that there are serious issues that do need to be discussed. And these comments shouldn’t be a distraction from them. I mean, why aren’t we closing the gap? Continue reading...

events.description: Emboldened by its win in Saxony-Anhalt, the far-right Alternative for Germany wants the government to change its Ukraine and Russia policies. Berlin is staying the course, but support is fading — especially in the east.

events.title: Berlin businesswoman charged with spying for Russia
events.description: Prosecutors say the Berlin marketing executive used her political and military contacts to help a Russian intelligence officer gain access to influential circles and seek information on German defense policy.

events.title: India women's team refuse Asia Cup cricket trophy from Pakistan minister
events.description: After beating Sri Lanka to win a record eighth Asia Cup title, the Indian women's cricket team skipped the trophy presentation with Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi.

events.title: Pay to ghost your boss: Japan's resignation business
events.description: Resignation agencies in Japan help employees leave their jobs seamlessly in just 15 minutes. Young people are especially eager to use their services.

events.title: Finland: EU leaders meet to forge new Arctic policy
events.description: European leaders are meeting over shipping, resources and security in the region amid pressure from the US, China and Russia. The EU sees the Arctic as key to its future security as melting ice makes it more accessible.

events.title: Bob Mackie, fashion designer for the stars, dies at 87
events.description: ⁠Hollywood designer ⁠Bob Mackie, ​known for making stars such as Cher and ​Elton John sparkle, died on Monday at 87, according to a post on his official Instagram account. His career ​spanned ‌five decades and included ⁠designing a Barbie doll clothes collection. FRANCE 24's Camille Knight has more.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Bob Mackie, fashion designer for the stars, dies at 87

events.title: 'The very existence of LGBTQI people is seen as obscene', Turkish activist says
events.description: Turkish police on Sunday swooped on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ activists, arresting at least 60 people in raids authorities said were aimed at boosting traditional family values, officials and activists said. Turkey's LGBTQ community has frequently been targeted by the government, with President Recep Tayyip Erdogan lashing it as a "deviant movement" of "perverts" responsible for the falling birth rate. FRANCE 24's Monte Francis speaks with Yildiz Tar, Editor-in-Chief of KaosGL.org.

events.title: Macklemore 'removed' from Ed Sheeran tour over 'Free Palestine' comment
events.description: US rapper Macklemore has claimed he's been removed as Ed Sheeran's tour opener after saying "Free Palestine" during a gig.

events.title: Putin ally paid for Trump Jr's wedding celebrations as 'extraordinarily generous gift'
events.description: Donald Trump Jr and his wife have said a Russian oligarch close to Vladimir Putin paid for two nights of their wedding celebrations as an "extraordinarily generous gift".

events.title: Woman, 54, gives birth after using embryo frozen for 22 years
events.description: A Greek woman has given birth aged 54, beating a government deadline to use one of her embryos, which had been frozen for 22 years.

events.title: Trump calls for Irish reunification - and claims 'it will happen eventually'
events.description: Donald Trump said he would "love to see" a reunified Ireland, claiming "it's going to happen eventually".
events.ticker_label: 💥 Trump calls for Irish reunification - and claims 'it will happen eventually'

events.title: Pope celebrates his 71st birthday but it's Vatican employees who get the gift
events.description: Pope Leo XIV has celebrated his 71st birthday but it is Vatican employees who got the gift

events.title: Houthis seize 2 strategic Red Sea islands, and other Mideast developments
events.description: Yemen's Houthi rebels have seized the strategic islands of Greater and Lesser Hanish in the southern Red Sea

events.title: Arctic thaw opens shipping routes as Russian buildup stokes security fears
events.description: Top European leaders are meeting in Finland to focus on the Arctic

events.title: Sweden's next government uncertain with thin lead for left-wing opposition
events.description: Sweden faces a potentially long wait for a new government as preliminary election results show a thin and still-uncertain lead for the left-leaning opposition, while a hard-right anti-immigration party saw its support slip

events.title: Countries must increase AI regulation to avoid ‘existential risks’: Türk
events.description: Voluntary self-regulation by companies developing frontier artificial intelligence (AI) is “nowhere near sufficient” to address existing harms and prevent advanced autonomous AI models from circumventing human safeguards, UN human rights chief Volker Türk wrote on Monday.

events.title: Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen
events.description: Fatimah* was 13 when she was married off to an older man. Two years later, she gave birth to twin daughters.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen

events.title: Lindsay Clancy juror denies bias allegations, wants 'conversation started' about women's mental health
events.description: A Lindsay Clancy trial juror pushes back on bias allegations, saying the jury saw holes in the prosecution's case involving postpartum psychosis.

events.title: Charles Manson cult follower Bruce Davis, convicted in two 1969 killings, dies behind bars at 83
events.description: Bruce Davis, a convicted Charles Manson family member tied to the murders of Donald Shea and Gary Hinman, has died at 83 in California prison.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Charles Manson cult follower Bruce Davis, convicted in two 1969 killings, dies behind bars at 83

events.title: Charlie Kirk statue defaced with red paint, Jesus crossed out days after 1-year mark of assassination
events.description: Red paint was smeared across the Charlie Kirk statue at Turning Point USA's Phoenix headquarters, with a Christian tribute defaced days after unveiling.

events.title: Could Africa be the next AI frontier as US and Europe hit limits?
events.description: U.S. companies are winning massive data center and AI deals across Africa, including a $6.2 billion project in Lesotho for hydropower and computing.

events.title: Indonesian passenger ship carrying 240 people loses contact in Java Sea, search underway
events.description: The Virgo Transport 8 vanished crossing the Java Sea with 240 people aboard en route from Surabaya to Banjarmasin, triggering an urgent search.

events.title: Saudi Arabia tells Trump now is the time for military action as Iran-backed Houthis advance
events.description: Houthi forces seized Perim island and key positions along Yemen's Bab al-Mandab Strait as Saudi Arabia urged Trump to take direct military action.

events.title: Philippines defense chief calls out China after note interrupts remarks at Seoul forum: 'Coercion, bullying'
events.description: Gilberto Teodoro read aloud a note from China handed to him mid-speech at the Seoul Defense Dialogue, calling it actual coercion and bullying.
